products.name: Box AI
products.note: Enterprise content AI; metadata; governance; compliance; retention policies

profile_text.body:
Box is a publicly traded company founded in 2005 and headquartered in Redwood City, California (ticker: BOX). The company describes itself as an intelligent content management platform built around unstructured data, offering tools for workflow automation, internal and external collaboration, document security, and compliance. Its platform is marketed to enterprises handling materials such as lease agreements, finance documents, sales presentations, and employee handbooks, with built-in support for requirements including GDPR, HIPAA, and FINRA.

The company's primary AI product is Box AI, which the site describes as drawing on models from OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google to provide real-time summaries, deep analysis, and recommendations across enterprise content. Box AI also underpins a drag-and-drop workflow builder for automating processes such as loan processing and employee onboarding, an AI-driven security layer with deep learning-based malware detection and automated data classification, and Box AI Studio for building and customizing AI agents. The site also notes unlimited e-signatures included at no additional cost within the platform.

Box files with the SEC under CIK 0001372612, and its most recently reported annual revenue, for the fiscal year ending January 31, 2026, was approximately $1.18 billion as recorded in its 10-K filing. No litigation or MCP registry entries are recorded in the held facts.
